VBO:0200329.summary: Fetch was seven-year-old Tuffy’s favorite game, and his keeper said this Chi-Poo still loved playing with toys. Another owner described Oreo, a Chihuahua–Poodle cross all grown up at two, as smart and full of character. Whenever the camera came out, Oreo insisted on having his picture taken too.
VBO:0200329.shortDescription: Tuffy’s keeper said this Chi-Poo loved fetch and toys; two-year-old Oreo’s owner described a dog keen to pose for photos.
